schema.schema: Field paths mapped to one-line descriptions; * denotes any policy name.
schema.evidence: MEASURED means expected values were computed by a deterministic toy campaign.
schema.inputs.targets: Target names in index and tie-break order.
schema.inputs.epochs_d: Fixed visit start epochs in days, ordered by slot.
schema.inputs.visibility: Boolean target-by-slot masks, sufficient to replay the known-orbit toy.
schema.inputs.detection_rewards: Reward for the first visible visit to each target.
schema.inputs.characterization_reward: Reward for the second visible visit; later visits earn zero.
schema.inputs.initial_state: Initial successful-visit counts, in target order.
schema.inputs.horizon_slots: Number of slots; at most one target or wait per slot.
schema.inputs.visit_cost_slots: Every visit consumes one slot, including unsuccessful visits.
schema.inputs.wait_cost_slots: Waiting consumes one slot and earns zero.
schema.inputs.integration_d: Planit action duration in days; slot occupancy is the binding cost.
schema.inputs.overhead_d: Zero slew and other overhead in this abstraction.
schema.inputs.seed: Null because the problem and all policies are deterministic.
schema.policies.*: Algorithm, planning depth and deterministic tie rules for each expected result.
schema.expected.*.utility: Computed Python float serialized without rounding.
schema.expected.*.sequence: Chronological target names or wait; modes follow the transition rule.
schema.expected.*.detections: Number of targets with at least one successful visit.
schema.expected.*.characterizations: Number of targets with two successful visits.
schema.tolerance.relative: Relative tolerance for utility comparisons; zero disables it.

inputs.transition: Wait or invisible visits leave state unchanged. First visible visit earns detection (imaging); second earns characterization (ifs); counts cap at two. All target choices remain allowed, including zero-gain visits.

policies.greedy: Receding lookahead of 1 visits including current slot, clipped at horizon; zero terminal value. Maximize total gain rounded to 12 decimal places, then immediate gain, then order wait,A,B,C.
policies.rollout_2: Receding lookahead of 2 visits including current slot, clipped at horizon; zero terminal value. Maximize total gain rounded to 12 decimal places, then immediate gain, then order wait,A,B,C.
policies.rollout_3: Receding lookahead of 3 visits including current slot, clipped at horizon; zero terminal value. Maximize total gain rounded to 12 decimal places, then immediate gain, then order wait,A,B,C.
policies.full_horizon: Receding lookahead of 4 visits including current slot, clipped at horizon; zero terminal value. Maximize total gain rounded to 12 decimal places, then immediate gain, then order wait,A,B,C.
policies.optimal: Enumerate all 4^4 sequences lexicographically in order wait,A,B,C; replace incumbent only if gain exceeds it by more than 1e-12.
policies.exact_package_selection: Per target in A,B,C order, enumerate empty, visible singletons, then ascending visible pairs; take Cartesian product, reject slot conflicts, retain first strict maximum of summed package rewards.
